title: Skip-link, focus-visible, and bypass-block static-report audit
hypothesis: A static audit can reject reports lacking a working first-use bypass mechanism, a unique main target, or visible keyboard focus while reserving manual and affected-user conformance.
falsifier_or_gate: Mutate link order, target identifier, target count, keyboard reachability, focus visibility, landmark role, hidden state, and completeness claim; broken bypass or promotion must fail.
boundary: Structural or proxy acceptance is confined to the declared model. It does not promote empirical, participant, authority, production, security, accessibility, identity, or Stage 20 claims.
